title: Documenting Gurindji Kriol, an Australian mixed language
text: Gurindji Kriol is an endangered mixed language spoken in Australia. It fuses Gurindji (Pama-Nyungan), with Kriol (English-lexifier) to create a unique system. Gurindji Kriol is an important language to younger Gurindji people, entailing both modern and traditional Aboriginal ideologies.
